description: Every relay list a Fermix release has shipped, oldest first (M62 §3.1, relay spec §5). Append a revision; never edit or remove one, and never drop a relay a revision named: relay names are repointed, not removed. A revision's id is the first 16 hex digits of the SHA-256 of its relays as canonical JSON. `iroh` is the iroh version the relays run, which the bundled helper must match.
